DeleteUIResource.description: The Method DeleteUIResource permanently removes a UI resource from the underlying system  memory.

ResourceName.description: The name of the UI resource to be deleted from the underlying system.

ExecutionFeedback.title: MethodExecutionFeedbackType
ExecutionFeedback.description: The MethodExecutionFeedbackType provides suitable feedback, both positive and negative, to an OPC UA client invoking a method.

Success.description: Returns True in case of successful execution.

Message.description: Array of detailed messages describing the reason for the unsuccessful execution or notice to the user.

items.title: MessageType
items.description: The MessageType provides a uniquely identified localised text.

ID.description: Unique identifier for the localised text.

LoadUIResource.description: The Method LoadUIResource loads a UI resource in the underlying system for visualization. It will  override the existing UI resource by the same name.

ResourceName.description: The name of the UI resource to be created in the underlying system.

ResourceValue.description: The value that the UI resource will obtain in the underlying system, i.e. the SVG file.

ExecutionFeedback.title: MethodExecutionFeedbackType
ExecutionFeedback.description: The MethodExecutionFeedbackType provides suitable feedback, both positive and negative, to an OPC UA client invoking a method.

Success.description: Returns True in case of successful execution.

Message.description: Array of detailed messages describing the reason for the unsuccessful execution or notice to the user.

items.title: MessageType
items.description: The MessageType provides a uniquely identified localised text.

ID.description: Unique identifier for the localised text.

PositionX.description: PositionX is the relative horizontal position of the top-left corner of the object rendering in the target  visualization scope.

PositionY.description: PositionX is the relative vertical position of the top-left corner of the object rendering in the target  visualization scope.

PositionZ.description: PositionZ is the depth of the object rendering in the target visualization scope.

Resizable.description: When Resizable is True, the UI resource Width is rescaled based on the actual display size.

Width.description: Width is the width of the object visualization in the target visualization scope.
